summary: Invalidate naming projections transactionally when a shared operation becomes conflicted.

replay.detail: Naming-bearing operation conflicts reuse the canonical naming reducer only below a measured domain-history cap; larger histories defer to explicit repair without receipt replay.

schema.detail: No schema changes; existing dirty and projection-health tables record invalidation and degradation.

rules.detail: Canonical naming and operation winner rules are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: No claim or wire format changes.

manual.detail: An above-cap naming conflict requires the existing explicit graph repair; naming and declaration reads fail closed until repair.

recovery.detail: A neutral claim conflicting with an earlier rename can no longer leave its cached naming projection reported healthy. Degradation stays visible to store health and recovery until successful repair.

downtime.detail: The ignored writer-held naming benchmark reports local p50 and p99; no production deployment timing is claimed.
